items.period: Shang (style label on the modern redraw)
items.caption: A modern redraw in oracle-script style. The early graph’s referent is disputed; this form does not establish whether it depicted a thumb, vessel, or another object.
items.alt: Oracle-script style rendering of 白; not an artifact photograph.
items.selection_reason: Retained as an early-style comparison; the competing origin accounts do not establish a reason to change the candidate.
items.rights: Wikimedia Commons declares the vector representation public domain.

items.period: Bronze-script style; Commons does not give a narrower date for this candidate
items.caption: A modern redraw in bronze-script style. It illustrates a script-style form and does not resolve the graph’s disputed origin.
items.alt: Bronze-script style rendering of 白; not a photograph of an inscribed bronze object.
items.selection_reason: Retained as a comparison with the oracle-style candidate; no new evidence requires a selection change.
items.rights: Wikimedia Commons declares the vector representation public domain and also notes a Richard Sears permission reference.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; Han-era dictionary tradition, not a dated artifact
items.caption: A modern redraw in Shuowen seal-script style. Shuowen explains 白 as 入 joined with 二; this transmitted explanation does not confirm the graph’s early origin.
items.alt: Shuowen seal-script style rendering of 白; not an artifact photograph.
items.selection_reason: Retained as a comparison with the transmitted dictionary tradition; no new evidence requires a selection change.
items.rights: Wikimedia Commons declares the vector representation public domain and also notes a Richard Sears permission reference.

limitations.text: These are modern redrawings in script styles, not photographs of specific inscribed artifacts. The source pages establish candidate identity and provenance, not a dated inscription context or the graph’s original referent.
